name: Steamer model, win backs at 10:00
hypothesis: The clean steamer model's top 5% shorten from 10:00 to the off and win more than their price says.

evidence.claim: research win A/E 1.155 at the morning price, 1.032 at the BSP; not significant on 33 days (p 0.16)
GBP50 to win, GBP100 a bet, GBP2,000 a day a model
kill switch: a failed S3 read reads as not stopped (fails open)

exit: each back laid at the Betfair SP for a liability equal to its winnings (the owner, 16 Nov 2026); 2022-26 at GBP50 to win, trade out GBP16,385 vs hold GBP19,779, daily sd 10.5 vs 64.5, deflated Sharpe 1.0
